items.title: Tyner McCoy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Bennie Maupin--Tenor Sax... Yourself... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, I enjoyed.

ctx.x: Can you give me a few names?

Oh sure. Lee Morgan trumpet, Julian Priester trombone, James Spaulding alto saxophone and flute, Bennie Maupin--Tenor Sax, Bob Northern--French horn, Howard Johnson­ -Tuba, Yourself, Herbie Lewis--Bass, and Joe Chambers on Drums.
